The Process

Submit once.
Ten experts evaluate.

Fast, honest and structured - the kind of pressure test that saves founders months of misdirected effort.

Describe your idea

Fill out a focused brief: what your business does, who it serves, your stage and market. No deck required.

Panel evaluates

Ten specialist agents review your submission across capital, demand, operations, channels and risk - independently.

Receive your verdict

A structured report with each panelist's score, their key concerns, and a single aggregate verdict with findings.

The Evaluators

Sample Output

What you receive.

A structured score from each panelist, their top concerns, and a clear aggregate verdict - not a list of platitudes.

The three possible outcomes

Go
Clear to proceed.

The panel sees credible demand, a workable model and acceptable risk. A strong signal to invest the next phase of effort.

Conditional Go
Proceed - but fix these first.

The idea has real merit, but specific gaps in model, channel or execution must be addressed before committing capital.

No Go
Don't proceed as defined.

The panel has identified structural obstacles - market, model or competition - that make the current approach unlikely to succeed.
